## Skills

**Fieldwork** — vegetation relevées, quadrat/transect surveys, functional trait collection (above- and belowground), biomass harvesting, phenological monitoring, soil sampling, permanent plot methods

**Field sites** — Southern Norway (Jotunheimen NP) · Svalbard (Isfjorden) · Swabian Alb, Germany · Greece · Israel · Brazil

**Statistics** — mixed models (LMM/GLMM), generalised additive models, quantile regression, multivariate analysis, bootstrapping, model diagnostics

**R** — tidyverse · ggplot2 · lme4 · nlme · MixSIAR · vegan · sf · terra · rgbif · GIFT · R Markdown · GitHub

**Languages** — German (native) · English (fluent)
